notes.title: CargoSpace has released!
notes.content:
As of today, CargoSpace has released on steam!


Thank you to all who have kept up with us over the past couple years of development and we hope you enjoy the game!

If you haven't seen it yet, here is the release trailer showing off snippets of the game!

[previewyoutube=Mmw64eaROm4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: CargoSpace has a release date!
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued interest in CargoSpace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43946179/d101eb56b6df33b6fcc577c6a559d64c8f46b1f4.png[/img]

We are proud to announce that the game is finished in its current state and will release on 12/17/24!
 

A trailer for the game with some of it's new features is up on YouTube and on the store page!

YouTube Link: https://youtu.be/rVApBvVyeJ0

notes.title: Demo Bug Fix!
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to fix some bugs within the game

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where player was returning from drop off, got stuck on ship
[*] Fixed bug where after fueling, player warp gets broken
[*] Fixed mouse cursor disappearing during a minigame when switching between devices fast enough
[*] Fixed glitch were minigame wont appear if player interacts with device too fast
[*] Fixed a bug where a game over screen hard locks the game 
[*] Disabled pausing during station landing in tutorial
[*] Fixed audio pop when leaving start ship and entering play area

[/list]

notes.title: CargoSpace at the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
CargoSpace has an updated demo for Steam Next Fest!

This new demo includes a new tier of levels with a new hazard! This update also includes a custom controls screen, a handbook detailing hazards in the game, and an updated start ship! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43946179/a6fa487c45f20e32eb5c15b081fe3b78ceb289f8.png[/img]
